thread:
maria: quick UX question on the prompt-sets "compact preview" mode we're prototyping. two bits: copy for the toggle, and how tiny diffs render inline. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/preview-compact

sam: for copy, prefer "Compact preview" over "Dense". clearer to non-power users. consider subtitle: "Show more diffs per screen".

devin: behavior note: in compact mode tiny 1-2 token diffs are noisy. proposal: collapse to an inline pill that reads e.g. "+1 token" with a chevron to expand. keeps scan fast.

casey: accessibility nits: 1) collapsed pill must be keyboard actionable and announce full diff when expanded. 2) toggle needs aria-pressed state and keyboard shortcut hint.

alex: color/contrast: the pale yellow diff highlight drops below 3:1 in dark theme. suggest fallback shades and an optional outline for emphasis. also add an icon (diff) so color isn't sole indicator.

sam: microcopy for pill: use "Show diff (+1 token)" instead of just "+1". helps screenreader users get context.

devin: undo toast for bulk approve in compact mode should include count and an accessible label: aria-live saying "5 items approved. Undo available." Also track metric compact_approve_undo_rate.

maria: good. i'll update the Figma: 1) toggle label "Compact preview — Show more diffs per screen", 2) collapsed pill "Show diff (+N)" clickable/keyboardable, 3) icon + color combo for highlights.

aria-bot: ticket UX-845 created: "compact preview collapsed diffs + a11y" assigned to @maria, labels: design, accessibility, product.

alex: i'll run contrast checks and post recommended hex swatches. happy to pair on keyboard affordances.

maria: thanks all. i'll post the updated frames here in ~90 mins. if anyone objects to the pill wording, shout now. :thumbsup:
